description: "Ellen Middleton—A Tale" by Georgiana Fullerton is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story centers around Ellen Middleton, a young woman whose life spirals into turmoil due to a tragic accident involving her cousin, Julia, which shatters her childhood innocence and peace.
